text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein in hospital for removal of knee cartilage.
- Parliament to discuss today new election law.
- Recent rains raise water levels in dams and aquifers.
- Prime Minister Kabariti says Jordan striving for self-sufficiency.
- Jordan National Bank and Business Bank merge.
- Lebanon formally rejects Jordan's complaint over release of three Iraqi diplomats charged with involvement in killing of Iraqi opposition figure, who had Jordanian nationality.
- Former Iraqi official Saad Bazaz denies he seeking political asylum in Britain.
- Jordan seeks better ties with Israel, but no carte blanche for Israeli moves, senior official says.
- Jordan stands by its protest against Lebanese release of Iraqi diplomats, Information Minister Muasher says.
